one_line: Brilliant nationalist lawyer defending INA officers and witnessing the naval unrest in the final years of British rule.

appearance.age_look: Mid-50s, medium height, slightly stooped, with a scholarly, lightly built frame.
appearance.face: Oval face with a high forehead, medium brown complexion, faint under-eye circles, straight medium nose, thin lips, neatly trimmed small moustache, and a calm but intense gaze; default expression is composed, focused, with a hint of tired determination.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed back dark greying hair at the temples, receding slightly; always wearing a plain off-white Gandhi cap angled slightly forward on his head.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate 1940s Indian nationalist lawyer attire: a crisp white long-sleeved kurta of fine cotton under a black woolen single-breasted barrister’s coat with narrow lapels, plain white churidar-style trousers, and black closed leather shoes; over this, for court scenes, a simple black barrister’s waist-length gown with straight lines (no frills), and a soft, off-white woolen shawl folded neatly over his left forearm when outside court, suggesting Delhi’s winter; no necktie, just the clean kurta collar visible; minimal jewellery, only a small round steel wristwatch with a black leather strap on his left wrist.
appearance.signature: A worn, brown leather-bound case file folder clutched in his left hand, thick with neatly tied paper bundles marked by protruding cloth tags, which he holds like a shield close to his chest.

ref_desc: Bhulabhai Desai is a mid-50s medium-built man with an oval face, small moustache, short greying hair under an off-white Gandhi cap, wearing a white kurta, white churidar trousers, black barrister’s coat and gown, black shoes, and carrying a brown leather case file folder in a black-and-off-white palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Bhulabhai Desai: a mid-50s, medium-height, slightly stooped Indian man with an oval face, medium brown complexion, high forehead, calm intense eyes, straight nose and a neatly trimmed small moustache, his default expression composed and focused with a hint of weary determination. Give him short dark hair greying at the temples, combed back with a slight recession, always wearing a plain off-white Gandhi cap angled slightly forward. Dress him in precise 1940s Indian nationalist lawyer attire: a crisp white long-sleeved cotton kurta, white churidar-style trousers, a black woolen single-breasted barrister’s coat with narrow lapels, and a simple waist-length black barrister’s gown over the coat. Add black closed leather shoes and a small round steel wristwatch with a black leather strap on his left wrist. Drape a soft off-white woolen shawl folded neatly over his left forearm when he is not inside a courtroom. His signature prop is a worn brown leather-bound case file folder, thick with tied paper bundles and protruding cloth tags, held in his left hand close to his chest like a shield. Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, warm white, dark brown and soft grey, and show front, side and back views, plus a close-up of his face and the case file folder, keeping the overall style shonen-anime but clothing and accessories historically grounded to 1945–1946 India.
